text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. It’s the fastest way to confirm the tool works without risking bad reviews. The trade-off is delayed feedback on other PRs, but safety first.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on merged PRs tests *past* work, not the *current* pipeline—it misses systemic issues in the newest open PRs where routing or prompts might have changed. Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *open* PR instead; if it flags nothing, then test on merged PRs to verify consistency. The real risk is assuming the tool works for the current state without checking where changes actually happen.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *open* PR first, then expand to merged PRs—this catches systemic issues early. Delaying the open PR check risks missing routing or prompt regressions that only appear in active workflows.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. This catches routing or prompt regressions before they hit merged PRs, where fixes are harder and slower. The trade-off is slightly delayed confirmation on merged PRs, but catching issues early saves more time than waiting to verify past work.
